chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:

"Treat the blessings of Allah well in your companionship with them, and beware lest they be transferred from you to others. Indeed, they have never departed from anyone at all and then nearly returned to him. And ʿAlī, peace be upon him, used to say: Little is it that a thing departs and then comes back."

key_terms.تَنْتَقِلَ: To move or be transferred away
key_terms.جِوَارَ: Companionship or neighboring relation, here meaning one’s manner of living with blessings
key_terms.نِعَمِ: Blessings and favors bestowed by Allah

ai.seo_question: How should a believer preserve Allah’s blessings and avoid losing them?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs believers to preserve divine blessings through good conduct and careful stewardship. It warns that blessings, once lost, seldom return, emphasizing gratitude, responsibility, and proper treatment of what Allah has bestowed.
